A fail-closed mechanism ensures that only buckets with sufficient decisive outcomes (≥5) produce actionable signals. This prevents overconfidence from sparse data. Bounded score ranges enforce deterministic behavior across all factors, ensuring that no single signal can dominate the final context score beyond predefined limits. These primitives together define a robust, deterministic, and conservative inference pipeline for game context evaluation.
